name: help
responses:
Here’s what I can help you with:

🟦 FOOD ORDERING
• Start an order: “I want to order food” / “I'm hungry”
• Add items anytime: “add fries”, “add a drink”
• Order pizza, burgers, fries, wings, drinks, desserts
• Ask for your saved order
• Cancel anytime

• Ask for the full menu
• Ask prices
• Check availability
